* Accepted standalone POR-subblock measurement fixture.
.lib "__MODEL_LIB__" tt

.include "__DUT_NETLIST__"
.option scale=1e-6 reltol=1e-4 abstol=1e-14
.temp -40
VDD vdd 0 1.8
VIN in 0 PWL(0 0 1u 0 11u 1.8 12u 1.8 22u 0 23u 0 33u 1.8 34u 1.8 44u 0 45u 0)
XDUT vdd in out 0 schmitt_trigger
CLOAD out 0 50f

.control
set noaskquit
set wr_singlescale
set wr_vecnames
set numdgt=12
save v(in) v(out) i(VDD)
tran 10n 45u 0 10n
wrdata wave.tsv v(in) v(out) i(VDD)
quit
.endc
.end
